Meowtext font collections

FIGlet and TOIlet
----------------
PyFIGlet 1.0.4 includes FIGlet and TOIlet fonts. See PyFIGlet-LICENSE.txt.
The additional collection is xero/figlet-fonts, revision
417429ef36ab039cbf192a4424c60aa23fc32de8:
https://github.com/xero/figlet-fonts/tree/417429ef36ab039cbf192a4424c60aa23fc32de8

Each font retains its original embedded author and redistribution notices.
TOIlet's font package notice is included in TOIlet-LICENSE.txt. Fonts shared
by both collections use the version bundled with PyFIGlet.

TheDraw
-------
1,198 TDF files, including colour, block and outline faces, from tdfiglet:
https://github.com/tat3r/tdfiglet/tree/0225b8881d06773b92d9db2c7881f03ff0bdece7

Both fonts/ and unused-fonts/ are included: Meowtext can read all three
TheDraw font formats. Font data and embedded names are unchanged; filenames
are uppercased for consistent portable project sources. Original authorship
is retained. See TheDraw-LICENSE.txt for the upstream distribution notice.

The source revisions and archive SHA-256 are recorded in catalogue-fonts.json.
The browser catalogue excludes fonts that have no visible sample; their
original files remain in the collection. Font families may have several
colour variants. Comparisons reduce duplicate shapes; Browse all retains
every indexed variant.

Rendering
---------
DejaVu Sans Mono supplies the cell glyphs: see DejaVu-LICENSE.txt.

Custom fonts imported into the studio remain on your device. They are not
included in these public collections or uploaded to the website.
